wing: named-problem partials (tier A def + tier B partial theorem)

targets.name: Brockian.RepunitPrimes.prime_of_repunit_prime
targets.statement:
theorem prime_of_repunit_prime {n : ℕ} (h : (repunit n).Prime) :
    Nat.Prime n
targets.rationale: Classical necessary condition for the repunit-primes problem: if R_n is prime then n is prime, because d | n forces R_d | R_n. Unconditional, and it is the standard first reduction of the search space (only prime indices need be tested).

targets.name: Brockian.PalindromicPrimes.eleven_dvd_of_palindrome_even_digits
targets.rationale: Every base-10 palindrome with an even number of digits is divisible by 11 (pair up digits at alternating positions in the divisibility-by-11 alternating sum). Hence 11 is the ONLY even-length palindromic prime — a complete, unconditional structural constraint on the open problem's search space.

targets.name: Brockian.LandauProblem.even_of_sq_add_one_prime
targets.statement:
theorem even_of_sq_add_one_prime {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n)
    (h : (n ^ 2 + 1).Prime) : Even n
targets.rationale: For n > 1, n^2 + 1 prime forces n even (odd n makes n^2+1 even and > 2). Unconditional parity constraint on Landau's problem.

targets.name: Brockian.LandauProblem.odd_prime_dvd_sq_add_one_mod_four
targets.rationale: Every odd prime divisor of n^2+1 is 1 mod 4 (-1 is a quadratic residue mod p). This is the classical arithmetic law behind the Landau frontier and constrains every factorization of n^2+1.

targets.name: Brockian.SierpinskiCovering.covering_78557
targets.rationale: The covering set {3,5,7,13,17,241} covers every exponent class: reduce n mod 24 and check the residue of 78557*2^n+1 in each class. A finite residue argument (no decide-bomb over all n), and the engine of the Sierpiński frontier.

targets.name: Brockian.ErdosStraus.erdosStraus_of_even
targets.statement:
theorem erdosStraus_of_even {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (he : Even n) :
    ErdosStrausSolvable n
targets.rationale: Constructive identity for the even residue classes: with n = 2m, 4/n = 2/m = 1/m + 1/(m+1) + 1/(m*(m+1)) after clearing denominators. Discharges half of all n unconditionally.

targets.name: Brockian.ErdosStraus.erdosStraus_of_mod_three_eq_two
targets.statement:
theorem erdosStraus_of_mod_three_eq_two {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (h : n % 3 = 2) : ErdosStrausSolvable n
targets.rationale: Constructive identity for n ≡ 2 mod 3: writing n = 3k + 2, 4/n = 1/n + 1/(k+1) + 1/(n*(k+1)) is an exact witness. Together with the even case this covers the classical easy residue classes of the Erdős–Straus problem.

targets.name: Brockian.LehmerTotient.squarefree_of_lehmerProperty
targets.statement:
theorem squarefree_of_lehmerProperty {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n)
    (h : LehmerProperty n) : Squarefree n
targets.rationale: Classical first step of Lehmer's problem: a Lehmer number is squarefree, since p^2 | n would give p | φ(n) | n-1 and p | n, a contradiction. Unconditional and the standard reduction used by every subsequent bound.
